title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.4.9
summary: Resolved Complaint Workflow Freeze & Stage Lock Protection
features: 🔒 Stage & Edit Lock: Once a complaint is marked Resolved, previous stages, re-resolving, editing details, follow-up visit logs, and payments are permanently frozen.
🛡️ Staff/Admin Reopen Control: Reopen flow is strictly accessible only to Admin and Staff; removed completely from technician views.
👁️ View-Only Documents: Attached documents and closing proofs cannot be deleted once tickets are resolved or closed.
